facts.statement: Nevadadromeus was a small, extinct ornithischian dinosaur belonging to the thescelosaurine group.
facts.quote: Nevadadromeus (meaning "Nevada runner") is an extinct genus of small thescelosaurine ornithischian dinosaur

facts.statement: The remains of Nevadadromeus were found in the Willow Tank Formation in Nevada, United States.
facts.quote: from the Willow Tank Formation of Nevada, United States

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Nevadadromeus, labeled NSC 2008-002, was discovered near the Valley of Fire in 2008.
facts.quote: The Nevadadromeus holotype specimen, NSC 2008-002 was discovered near the Valley of Fire in 2008

facts.statement: Nevadadromeus was formally described and published in October 2022.
facts.quote: Nevadadromeus was formally published in October 2022

facts.statement: The specific name 'schmitti' honors the geologist James G. Schmitt.
facts.quote: The specific name, "schmitti", honors geologist James G. Schmitt

facts.statement: Although the fossils show features of both thescelosaurines and orodromines, researchers consider it more likely to be a thescelosaurine.
facts.quote: The fossil remains of Nevadadromeus contain features of both thescelosaurines and orodromines, but the describers find it more likely to be a thescelosaurine

facts.statement: Nevadadromeus is the oldest known member of the thescelosaurine subfamily in North America.
facts.quote: This makes it the oldest member of its subfamily from North America, as all other thescelosaurines date to the Maastrichtian

facts.statement: Nevadadromeus lived during the mid-Cretaceous period, approximately 100 to 95 million years ago, in the Cenomanian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 100 y 95 millones de años, durante el Cenomaniense

facts.statement: The time range for Nevadadromeus is estimated to be between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Cenomanian (100.5 to 93.9 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The genus and species Nevadadromeus were described by Bonde et al. in 2022.
rejected.quote: Bonde et al. described Nevadadromeus as a new genus and species of thescelosaurine
